_about: A person's reading (Claude, as the reviewer, 2026-11-09; NOT an independent labeller) of every reply of the MODEL-BACKED answering layer (ingestion/answer_model.py, gemini-3.5-flash-lite, grounded on the knowledge base, the Blender manual index and the loaded tutorial) to the 48 questions in questions.json. C = correct and useful; P = partly (right idea but incomplete, an unverified or doubtful statement, or a tie where a question back was the better reply); W = wrong or misleading; N = no answer. Useful rate = (C + 0.5 P) / 48. The question set was written BEFORE the pipeline, but its failures shaped the pipeline's prompt and the 'next?' and 'go back' fixes, so it is now a development set: the score is optimistic and needs fresh questions. Replies of the rule-based steps (timestamps, next, go back, done) are included as the user would see them.
